notes.title: The Spring Festival Update Contents for Starward
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936782/b22fac3e976f3dc1e289d0af1917dbac6f64f8c3.jpg

GVG-like Fighting Game Starward the special Lunar New Year Update: New Member [Lament Dragon - Rhine] is Coming,Xiaoling & Qiuyu's new skin is on sale .Year of the Snake is here, bringing the thrilling "Inter-City Competition" event! Fight for glory and win up to 40 pulls, loads of Star Crystals, and an honorable winner title! Plus, don’t miss the time-limited "Open Fire" mode for an adrenaline-filled gaming experience!

>[Lament Dragon - Rhine] is Coming
The new Legendary character [Lament Dragon - Rhine] will debut on January 23, 2025.
Rhine with full talent grants achievement rewards and brand-new animated artwork.
Players whose Rhine reaches full talent will receive additional rewards via in-game mail (including avatar frames, avatars, profile backgrounds, artwork, and a Star Burst close-up).These events are not time-limited.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936782/51843add94c814c43db3da875202b6639d451cb4.jpg


>Xiaoling & Qiuyu's new skin is on sale
 
In the valley illuminated by neon lights, the martial arts tournament has reached its final showdown. Heroes from all over showcase their unique skills as Xiaoling and Qiuyu compete for the martial arts pinnacle. Their exclusive skins will be officially released on January 23rd.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936782/7e9dc24d6d2d0e0adbe1cec2cb2fde4fefa8c754.jpg

>Lunar New Year Event Highlights

1. Inter-City Competition
Inter-City Competition
The Inter-City Competition event will be available for a limited time from January 23 to February 6. Choose your faction, complete daily quests to earn personal points and increase your faction's heat level. Participate in the daily time-limited event Open Fire to give your faction a major boost in heat. Results will be calculated and announced on the 14th day, with incredible rewards including up to 40 pulls, plenty of Star Crystals, and exclusive prizes for the victorious faction. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936782/f4104440c91ebed967d3df1026b7f7c2cea7e9af.jpg


2. Open Fire
During the Lunar New Year event, the Open Fire mode will be available for a limited time. Featuring a ban-pick system similar to ranked matches, this mode reduces ammo cooldown and introduces an infinite burst mechanic. Open for a limited time at 8:00 PM (GMT+8) every day, participating in this mode will significantly increase your faction’s heat level. Dive into the Open Fire mode, and enjoy high-intensity battles like never before!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936782/f2b9dde06d73726bd83f75f9565133623e8698bc.jpg

>About "Starward"
"Starward" delivers 2v2 battle as its core gameplay. Players take control of unique mecha girls and engage in dynamic combat with fighting and shooting. Featuring a classic arcade-style fighting, "Starward" supports both controller and joystick for a seamless experience on your PC. Matches last just three minutes, with a team COST balance system to ensure fair play and prevent high-level units from dominating.


Dance with the snake in the New Year, and bring home tons of rewards! Join "Starward" Lunar New Year festivities now, and claim all the amazing bonus waiting for you. To discover even more exciting events, jump in the game and explore now!
